scientific_question: On the already consumed p=33kw_size=03 public development trajectory, does a numerically equivalent fused native implementation translate the frozen w16d2 Dual-K1 2A+2A^T path into at least 10 percent lower fresh-process end-to-end wall time without more than 5 percent whole-worker peak-RSS harm relative to Zero-CGLS K4 4A+4A^T?

single_run_control.canonical_parent_chain_receipt: PARENT_VALIDATION_BOUND_V16_1.json beside the parent v16 release
single_run_control.canonical_resource_release: RESOURCE_RELEASE_V16_1.json beside the parent v16 release
single_run_control.canonical_run_open_receipt: RESOURCE_RUN_OPENED_V16_1.json beside the parent v16 release
single_run_control.canonical_output_directory: independent_resource_v16_1 beside the parent v16 release
single_run_control.boundary: O_EXCL and canonical paths prevent an accidental or policy-compliant second batch, but a privileged local actor could delete all receipts and rerun; the final claim must not describe cryptographic one-time acceptance.

frozen_arms.path: native G_theta(y) -> exact A^T -> observable alpha in [0,2] -> unchanged strict CGLS K1 -> streaming field write
zero initialization -> unchanged strict CGLS K4 -> streaming field write

execution.arm_order: alternate the leading arm by repetition index so each arm leads exactly nine repetitions
execution.external_wall_scope: parent timer immediately before subprocess execve through child exit; includes Python startup, imports, observation load, geometry construction, checkpoint and native-context load for the candidate, solver execution, fsync field output, report serialization, and process teardown
execution.external_wall_excludes: one-time native library compilation performed before all worker repetitions
execution.peak_RSS_scope: whole worker process from parent os.wait4 child rusage after process exit; no worker child process is permitted
execution.CPU_time_scope: child user plus system CPU seconds from the same parent os.wait4 record
execution.thread_disclosure: candidate uses one main thread, four persistent native proposal workers, and at most one asynchronous coordinator; reference uses one main thread

decision_rule: Numerical equivalence, deterministic repeats, exact operator ledgers, paired wall median reduction, paired faster fraction, paired wall no-harm, peak-RSS ratio, and child total-CPU-time ratio must all pass. No average-gain override and no threshold change after execution are allowed.

failure_actions.source_input_or_numerical_mismatch: invalidate the resource profile without changing the v16 accuracy-and-call result
failure_actions.wall_failure: retain the v16 accuracy-and-call result but do not claim end-to-end acceleration
failure_actions.RSS_failure: retain the v16 accuracy-and-call result but do not claim whole-pipeline memory no-harm
failure_actions.CPU_time_failure: retain any elapsed-wall observation as an implementation result but do not claim compute-cost no-harm
failure_actions.any_resource_failure: freeze the result and do not tune the runtime on this consumed trajectory
